credits.title: Credits
credits.imagesNote: Images are self-hosted copies, resized and converted to modern formats. Cropped versions are marked as such.
credits.ornamentNote: The kawung motif is a classical Javanese pattern, adapted here as a vector; it is not presented as a Mangkunegaran motif. Parang is not used: mangkunegaran.id describes it as a restricted (larangan) motif inside the palace.
credits.coloursNote: The royal green and antique gold are sampled from the official website mangkunegaran.id as a design reference. They are not an official colour specification.

translation.title: Translation status
translation.intro: What has been translated, and how far it can be trusted.
translation.legend: Original: written for this site from the cited sources. AI draft: translated with an AI assistant, awaiting native review. Not yet: shown in English, or in Indonesian for Javanese readers.
translation.javanese: No native Javanese reviewer has signed off yet, so all Javanese text and Aksara Jawa titles are marked as awaiting review.
